items.en: Background tasks wait out provider rate limits and show when they are waiting. Each provider can limit how many requests run at once.
items.zh: 后台任务遇到服务商限流时会等待并显示“等待中”；可为每个服务商设置同时请求数上限。

items.en: Each AI task can set its own output limit under Advanced, also when its model is on Auto.
items.zh: 可在“高级”中为每项 AI 任务单独设置输出上限，模型为“自动”时同样生效。

items.en: Changing the search model asks for confirmation when files already have search vectors that would be rebuilt.
items.zh: 更换搜索模型时，如果已有文件需要重新计算搜索向量，会先请你确认。

items.en: The model picker shows each on-server model's size, speed and accuracy, and on-server OCR models download only when first needed.
items.zh: 模型选择器会显示服务器本机模型的大小、速度和准确程度，本机 OCR 模型改为第一次用到时再下载。

items.en: Command palette submenu arrows now align to the right edge, and the ask row reads "Sem:".
items.zh: 命令面板中子菜单箭头改为靠右对齐，提问一行改为显示「Sem：」。

items.en: Improved search accuracy for common embedding models, smaller Gemini vectors, and support for services that accept only small batches.
items.zh: 提升常用向量模型的搜索准确度，缩小 Gemini 向量占用的空间，并支持单次只接收少量文本的服务。

items.en: Search falls back to keywords within seconds when the embedding model is slow.
items.zh: 向量模型响应慢时，搜索会在几秒内改用关键词返回结果。

items.en: Long syllabi and scanned documents import reliably, and reading them is faster and cheaper.
items.zh: 较长的课程大纲和扫描件可以稳定导入，读取速度更快、费用更低。

items.en: Rebuilding search indexes and downloading models no longer hold up imports and new files.
items.zh: 重建搜索索引和下载模型不再阻塞导入和新文件的处理。

items.en: Faster local OCR and local search when users choose different models.
items.zh: 本机 OCR 更快；用户选用不同本机搜索模型时不再反复加载模型。
